'So boyfriend material:' ARMY can't get over BTS Jin's effortlessly stylish look in Brazil during ARIRANG World Tour
 Karen Noronha Oct 31, 2026, 12:44 IST 3 min read As photos and videos from BTS' Brazil shows circulated online, Jin's outfit quickly became a talking point, with fans struggling to look away from his effortless charm.
 BTS have been bringing their long-awaited group performances to stadiums across the world, but the ARIRANG World Tour has also given fans plenty of moments to obsess over beyond the music. From the members embracing local culture to their interactions with ARMY, each stop has added something memorable to the group's return to the global stage.
Their São Paulo concerts have been no exception. As photos and videos from the Brazil shows circulated online, one member's understated outfit quickly became a talking point, with fans struggling to look away from his effortless charm.
 Image credit : X/@ALittleBraver92 | Kim Seok-jin, better known as Jin, had fans swooning over his outfit. BTS Jin's Brazil concert look has ARMY swooning
 Kim Seok-jin, better known as Jin, had fans swooning after appearing in a white striped shirt, a tie in the similar pattern paired with blue-washed jeans during BTS' São Paulo concert Day 2.
With his hair styled to reveal his forehead, the singer kept the look simple yet effortlessly stylish, creating the kind of casual appearance that quickly caught ARMY's attention.
 Image credit : X/@jinniesarchives | BTS' Jin kept the look simple yet effortlessly stylish. Photos and clips from the performances, particularly the October 30 show, spread across social media as fans praised his visuals. The familiar nickname World Wide Handsome (WWH) made another appearance in fan reactions, while many described his relaxed concert styling as the ultimate boyfriend look.

— Agust D girl🫶🏻✨ (@RimpaGh22229117) October 31, 2026 BTS ARIRANG World Tour makes history in São Paulo
 BTS performed at São Paulo's Estádio do MorumBIS on October 28, 30 and 31, 2026, as part of the Latin American leg of their ARIRANG World Tour. The concerts marked a major milestone, with BTS becoming the first Asian act to headline the iconic stadium. The opening night reportedly drew an attendance of more than 81,000 people.
The Brazil shows also brought special moments into the setlist. BTS performed the full choreography for IDOL for the first time on the tour, while the members incorporated local Brazilian dance styles, including Passinho do Jamal.
 BTS delivers incredible synchronisation while performing “IDOL” at their SOLD-OUT show in Brazil. https://t.co/gaZ0WqSOns
— Pop Core (@TheePopCore) October 31, 2026 They also interacted with the crowd in Portuguese, adding a local touch to the performances and making the São Paulo concerts particularly memorable for fans.
 BTS ARIRANG World Tour: Where will the group perform next?
 The ARIRANG World Tour supports BTS' 10th studio album, Arirang, and marks the group's return to large-scale touring after completing their mandatory military service. Following the Latin American leg, which concludes in São Paulo on October 31, the group is set to continue across Asia and Oceania through early 2027.
 Image credit : X/@bts_bighit | The Latin American leg concludes in São Paulo on October 31. The upcoming tour dates include Kaohsiung, Taiwan, on November 19, 21 and 22 at Kaohsiung National Stadium; Bangkok, Thailand, on December 3, 5 and 6 at Rajamangala National Stadium; and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, on December 12 and 13 at TM Stadium Nasional. BTS will then perform in Singapore on December 17, 19, 20 and 22 at the National Stadium, before heading to Jakarta, Indonesia, for shows on December 26, 27 and 29 at Gelora Bung Karno Main Stadium.
